english: Like I could hold back against you lot...
Your dream, Kondo...? Let's go look, then.
If you're going, so are we.
You can search for your dream, Kondo.
Kondo. Maybe pick someone else to dream about.
Hey! Wait! That's not Gin Tama!
Shut up... What are you doing here?
Screw you! This is MY route!\fYou don't need to show up!
What kind of game is THAT?!
Otae! At least take the dango!
Oh, Toshi and Sougo! How'd you find me?
Well, sit down. Have some dango.
Fine by me. We can make our new home here.
Heh. Collected loads on duty these past few days.
Right. We'll let you off for today.
Heh... Didn't think you'd fight so seriously...
Personal collecting isn't banned. My chance to seize a dream!
No. You don't have to come too.
I see... You really are idiots.
To be with Otae, of course!
Then tell me YOUR dream, Otae!
Leave it to me! I'll make it come true!
Nonsense! This won't make me give up!
Two against one or not, a win's a win.
Why did it end like this?!
No, I mean you'll lose, Hijikata.
Kondo's collected loads of Gin Tama so he can be with Otae.
What are you saying? Don't get the wrong idea.
No need to treat us like strangers.
Hey! Take this stalker home! Now!
Don't act like this is your HOME!
Never mind that. Look at this, would you?
Sougo. This is her dojo, right?
Someone who looked like Kondo bought dango at the shop, right?
Why didn't we think of this place first?
We're going in. What a pain.
No, I've got a feeling too...
YOU said it, Hijikata. Forgotten already?
Been wondering... Is that topknot a wig?
Whatever... Ever found Gin Tama round here?
Tch! Showing up here of all places...
Got sharp ears, that old man.
That old man's drunk in broad daylight?
What now? Keep looking for Gin Tama?
Reminded me of someone I hate...
Important things are never around when you look for them...
Well, back to looking for Saburo.
Let's ask someone first.\fShinsengumi. Got some questions.
Gin Tama owners were attacked.\fCulprit's a big mechanical doll, apparently.
Otae said she found Gin Tama by the river.
Of course! I'll seize my dream myself!
Yeah. So easy to find when you DON'T need them.
But you're free to collect them personally.
I don't like that sort of thing.
Hey, young as you are, already bowing to the powerful?
See ya. Got some fun waiting tonight.
Saw a big contraption earlier... It doesn't attack people, does it...?
Got a bad feeling... Like something terrible's about to happen...
Shall we go under the bridge?
Funny, since every other word's cut your belly.
Well, I AM a celebrity, in a way.
Yeah, but you can find Gin Tama all over the place.
Well, good luck with work, anyway. Okay?
Did she really find a Dragon Tama here?
Can't help it. Let's look harder...
Sorry for not playing along!\fThis is why I hate the press.
